task:
Fast targeted diagnosis of TERMINAL WIN native headless portal clickers. Symptom after current parallel eeaa0e471411045d65295fdc513b28986bd2b46e: updater successfully downloads/starts the new Windows worker and GUI shows many accounts as RUNNING for sustained time, but NONE of those characters are visible/logged into the game world. Normal WoW.exe clients using the same accounts/server log in and work. Prior updater log proved StartTerminalWindowsWorkerAsync sees the worker process alive and reports ACTIVE/RUNNING; this is process liveness, not proof of SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD. We recently added OctoLogin-style AuthEndpointSelector and then fixed reconnect churn (clear transient failed endpoints each connect pass, portal minimum 600 retries x 1000ms).

Please inspect ONLY the exact Windows headless login path needed to explain RUNNING-without-world: tools/updater/UpdaterWindowsTerminalPortalFeature.cs, probes/Wow112HeadlessAndroid/src/main.rs, auth_endpoint.rs, auth.rs, world_portal.rs, wire_build.rs, and the Windows build workflow patches. Determine the most likely root cause(s) that keep the process alive before character login/world entry. Pay special attention to: realm selection/index and workflow runtime patching; character selection/login packet flow; whether portal loop/reconnect treats a pre-world auth/login stall as transient; whether selector probes or shared cache can select an endpoint that accepts auth challenge but is wrong for real SRP/realm list; whether the GUI RUNNING state masks no-progress; and whether any timeout/error strings are missing from is_transient_network_error causing a stuck or misleading process state.

Return a decisive compact report: (1) most likely root cause ranked, (2) exact file/symbol evidence, (3) smallest safe code fix, (4) whether to rollback selector or keep it, (5) 6 must-pass tests. Do not edit files. Avoid broad repo audit. Under 1000 words.
